g.text: Phase 17 Code-to-Spec Coverage + Phase 18 Test-Mapping Accelerator
exact Cargo target + feature shard owner
owning Cargo target + cfg(test) module graph
Pending and rejected proposals are quarantined.
They do not feed catalog, coverage, debt retirement,
A route may coexist with its original C4 code/spec demand.
It binds exact behavior rows and route provenance for quarantine only.
It has no write edge into the code map or specification gaps and cannot
promote catalog, coverage, proof, claims, or zero-equation state.
Trace production consumes each isolated LLVM export once. The receipt binds
the canonical trace, requested identities, profiles, executables, LLVM tools,
and covered source bytes. Reuse revalidates those bytes and cannot bypass
source-commit, identity-set, schema, or raw-evidence checks.
Coverage, names, paths, and mutation kills are not semantic proof.
Each assertion is bound to exact oracle behavior rows;
high-risk mappings require two distinct reviewers.
Reassignment preserves one DISC / TEST identity, requires fresh proposal,
assertion, trace, and two-reviewer authority, replaces uniquely owned current
provenance, and moves both invariant backlinks in one atomic transaction.
It cannot append a duplicate test or retain cross-area authority.
Profiles close package, target, binary, and module-prefix identity.
The dedicated shard owner copies those properties per test before grouping,
and separates default-feature from no-default-feature commands.
The browser-analysis profile executes native Rust facade tests only;
it does not claim wasm32, JavaScript, or rendered-browser proof.
The ADS-core profile is closed to mapping.rs, quality.rs, and symbols.rs;
it makes no external ADS endpoint or TwinCAT interoperability claim.
The runtime bundle-builder profile is closed to its unit-test module;
it does not promote graph fixtures to general filesystem or registry proof.
The ST test CLI profile is closed to one integration target and may bind
assertions across reviewed reporting, execution, and build invariants.
Module imports are retained even for wrapper modules with no functions.
Private sibling imports and private targets do not leak, cycles terminate,
and multiple qualified helper targets remain ambiguous rather than proof.
Repository inputs require literal roots and extensions and bind every
matching regular file digest. Generated files must remain under a validated
test temp root. The Linux process-status reader is fixed and argument-free.
Dynamic, escaping, symbolic-link, and arbitrary report paths fail closed.
Focused pilot and implementation shards reconstruct only requested
reviewed source files and fail on stale identity. They do not rerun
the whole-repository test scanner. The scanner remains authoritative
for the single final denominator campaign.
This plane has no write edge into the accepted map.
Reported facts stay untrusted until live reconstruction.
It cannot infer bindings, close gaps, promote proof,
or refresh digests without an explicit reviewed transaction.
Code coverage cannot promote product proof,
close a specification gap, or replace rendered UI evidence.
registered_backlog remains unresolved for exact fact bindings
but is excluded from planner area expansion.
candidates only; no proof or writes
